purpose: Own the current Algebra 1 Portfolio status, rollup, and Quick Check mechanics while Unit Assessment Plans continue to own exact Unit learning content.
authority_scope: default I Can mastery sufficiency rule

i_can_statuses.label: No Evidence
i_can_statuses.meaning: No usable demonstrated evidence is currently available for the I Can.

i_can_statuses.label: Developing
i_can_statuses.meaning: Some usable evidence exists, but mastery is not yet established.

i_can_statuses.label: Mastered
i_can_statuses.meaning: The body of evidence supports secure independent performance under the current rule and teacher judgment.

i_can_statuses.label: Transfer
i_can_statuses.meaning: The I Can is securely mastered and the body of evidence includes meaningful transfer/extension evidence.

mastered_default_rule.normal_requirement: At least two independent convincing demonstrations, normally from different opportunities, with at least one reasonably current demonstration.
mastered_default_rule.rich_artifact_exception: A rich artifact may be sufficient when it contains multiple genuinely independent convincing demonstrations.
mastered_default_rule.mixed_evidence: Teacher professional judgment resolves mixed or unusual cases.
mastered_default_rule.later_weak_event: One later weak event does not automatically remove established mastery; record the contradiction and seek another look when warranted.
mastered_default_rule.accommodations: Approved accommodations do not lower the evidence status of a valid demonstration.

mastery_goal_rule.demonstrated_when: At least 2 of 4 I Cans are Mastered or Transfer.

unit_scale.label: Mastery + Transfer
unit_scale.rule: 4 of 4 Mastery Goals demonstrated plus meaningful transfer/extension evidence

powerschool_rule: One living assignment per unit. Current official status replaces the prior status; attempts are not averaged. Earlier Unit status may improve later when new valid evidence demonstrates an older Unit I Can.

quick_check.live_selection_rule: Curriculum predicts evidence slots. Portfolio selects current reassessment I Cans from live need. Teacher approves/edits the actual questions.
quick_check.question_mapping: Each question has one primary I Can evidence target unless a richer task genuinely provides separately judgeable evidence for more than one target.
quick_check.versioning_rule: When parallel print versions are built, preserve target/representation/reasoning/difficulty, scramble appropriately, and keep one identical common item across versions for fairness/comparison.

checkpoint.selection_rule: Use live Portfolio need to choose current-unit gaps, older-unit reassessment, and transfer/extension when appropriate.

legacy_retirements: Not Yet / Approaching / Meeting / Exceeding as current Algebra Portfolio status labels
fixed previous-section Exit Ticket reassessment chain
